<!-- pr-reviewer: e0e4fee6813d145189f87ca2b8eb62882a2064d9 -->
Needs changes before merge: two findings. All local checks passed.

I read the whole PR diff and issue #2756. I checked the rules on upstream main `3b4c4b2cb8d48d9442466b23e49f1962d38b4f6d`.
The local trial merge is `c3906cc045f9216f2e474b76ac66459fbae838b1`. Its first parent is the PR head above.

The tests cover unknown keys, axis removal, saved-file read-back, and the split between work and tool axes.
This is a safety-tier review: the edited values feed clearance checks and post kinematics.

**Requested before merge**

1. **Class: repeated frame computation.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_axis_chain.rs:96` builds the axis rows on each frame. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_file_editor.rs:256` builds them again for the refusal keys. The row draw also builds the notes again. These calls walk the JSON tree and build derived lists when the input has not changed. This breaks the current `crates/ui/AGENTS.md` Frame cost rule. Cache the rows, row keys and notes with their input owner. Invalidate the cache when the draft changes. Add a counter test for unchanged frames and a test for changed input. Add the required `frame_cost::span` for the new frame work. Apply this rule to the whole new axis group, not only one call.
2. **Class: missing UI evidence.** The UI change at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/machine_file_editor.rs:262` needs before/after screenshots in the PR body. The body links one screenshot of the new editor. I checked the image; it has no before view. Add a screenshot of the same pane before this change. Label the two views. Keep the images on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch and link them from the body.

**Local results**

All commands ran locally, in the foreground, on the trial merge. No GitHub runner was used.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 124 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 11.1 minutes.
- App `machine`: 57 passed, 0 failed. This includes the 24 new app tests.
- UI library, from `crates/ui`: 1,615 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored. This includes the seven new UI tests.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: six steps, all 11 light tests passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 19.5 minutes.
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

**Extra suites run**

The quick gate ran these suites by name:

- `example_catalog`: 41 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `first_part_programs`: passed.

The PR changes no import code or test-data directory. The extra importer and fixture suites do not apply.

**Mutation checks**

The body gives no mutation record. I ran two independent probes on scratch copies in `/tmp`. The review worktree stayed unchanged.
The scratch project used an exact copy of `chain.rs` and its two helper functions.

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Store `1` instead of `-1` for a reversed linear axis | `reverse_roundtrip` failed: actual `Some(Number(1))`, expected `Some(Number(-1))` |
| Disable the work/tool guard in `move_axis` | `refuse_work_tool_swap` failed: `a table rotary must not trade places with a head rotary` |

Both tests passed before the mutations. Both passed after the exact source was restored.

Goldens moved: none. The PR changes no recorded NC program or catalog file.
No full heavy lane was run, as the current upstream review rules require for this P6 issue.
No end-to-end program was posted from a machine file saved by this editor.

The PR is mergeable. I left its draft state, labels and title unchanged, as instructed for this review.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Thanks for the review. Both findings are addressed in `e1ac7b786`.

1. **Repeated frame computation.** The axis rows, each row's notes and the refusal keys that show at a row are now built once per edit, in `MachineDraft::chain_view` (`crates/app/src/machine/chain_view.rs`). The draft is the file's one writer: `value` is private, read with `value()`, and every write, `value_mut()` included, drops the view. The editor reads the view once per frame, in the spans `ui/machines.editor.axis_chain.view` and `ui/machines.editor.axis_chain`.
   - Counter test: `the_axis_chain_is_built_once_per_edit_of_the_machine_file` in `frame_cost_caches.rs`. Still frames and typing in the "add axis" form build nothing; an added axis and a write to the JSON build again, equal to a fresh build.
   - App pins in `chain_view.rs`: a read with no write builds nothing; each write (add, move, turn, reverse, remove, a hand write, a field elsewhere) gives the fresh build's view.
   - Mutation probes, restored after: a `clear` that drops nothing, and a memo that builds on every read, each turn these pins red.
   - The draft's `refusals()` and `groups()` still run on each frame, as on `main` before this PR. I left them, since they are not this group's. Say if you want them in this PR too.
2. **Before/after screenshots.** The body now has a labelled before (v0.26.0, the same grblHAL machine, no Axis chain group) and after, both on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.

Readings on the new head: quick 124 steps, 0 failed; light 4 steps, 0 failed; clippy on the three crates passed.

Clean review. Both earlier findings are fixed. No blocking findings remain.

I read the full diff, the fix commit, issue #2756, and the author's reply.
I used the current rules on upstream main `d80dc6944f912171a06029f635e0450c505d44a9`.
The local trial merge is `55635ca820f0e9ba0cd9aea5709113a93b9289d6`. Its first parent is the PR head above.

**Earlier findings**

1. **Repeated frame computation: fixed in `e1ac7b786`.** `MachineDraft` now owns the cache in `chain_view.rs`. All writes invalidate it, including writes through `value_mut()`. The editor reads the cached rows, notes, and refusal keys. Both frame spans are present. The app tests check unchanged reads and changed input. The UI counter test `the_axis_chain_is_built_once_per_edit_of_the_machine_file` passed.
2. **Missing UI evidence: fixed.** I opened both images in the body. They show the same grblHAL machine editor before and after the Axis chain group. Both images are on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.

**Local results**

All builds and tests ran locally in the foreground. No GitHub runner was used.

- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=16 cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 124 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 7.0 minutes.
- App `machine`: 57 passed. App unit tests: 313 passed.
- UI unit tests, from `crates/ui`: 1,665 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored. This includes the new axis and cache tests.
- `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=16 cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: six steps, all 11 light tests passed, 0 failed, 0 stalled; 6.2 minutes.
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

**Extra suites run**

The quick gate ran these suites by name:

- `example_catalog`: 43 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `first_part_programs`: passed.

The PR changes no import code or fixture directory. The extra importer and fixture rules do not apply.

**Mutation checks**

This is a safety-tier review: the edited values feed clearance checks and post kinematics.
I repeated both cache mutations from the body in a disposable copy of the trial merge under `/tmp`.
The review worktree's source stayed unchanged.

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Make `Memo::clear` keep the cached view | RED: `every_write_gives_the_view_a_fresh_build_gives` failed on the first added rotary. |
| Make `Memo::get` build on every read | RED: `a_read_with_no_write_between_builds_nothing` counted 5 builds instead of 0. |

Both tests passed before the mutations. Both passed after the exact source was restored.

Goldens moved: none. No recorded NC/CL program or catalog file changed.
No full heavy lane was run, under the current review rules for this P6 issue.
No end-to-end program was posted from a file saved by this editor.

The PR is mergeable. I left its labels, title, and draft state unchanged, as instructed.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Please mark this PR ready with `gh pr ready 3922 -R NeoTech/Camcraft` so it can merge on this review.
